notes.title: Dive Deep with Leila: Every Purchase Helps WDC Protect Marine Life
notes.content:
We are excited to announce our support for Whale and Dolphin Conservation (WDC) for World Oceans Day!


WDC's World Oceans Day Sale begins on June 5 and runs through June 12. During the event, you can take advantage of a great discount for Leila. Additionally, we will donate a portion of the proceeds from the event to support WDC's conservation efforts.

WDC, Whale and Dolphin conservation is the leading global charity dedicated to the protection and conservation of whales and dolphins. 

By participating in this event, we will help WDC continue its global conservation work and ghost gear removal project, and contribute to funding 10 missions for divers to remove deadly entanglements for marine life (and scuba divers) from reefs, seabeds, and shipwrecks in UK waters.

notes.title: Patch Notes (1.0.3)
notes.content:
Hi everyone! Thanks for playing our game and reporting bugs! Here is our second patch of the full release. Just some teeny-tiny fixes and improvements. Nothin' fancy here.

1.0.3 

- FIX: Mancave JigsawPiece dragging bug:
I Receive: No more cursor-loving-sticky-object bug;
You Receive: No more rotating while dragging
- UPD: Hold button behaviours improved:
We noticed that hold interaction feedbacks on New Game button in Main Menu and Quit Game button in Pause Menu are unclear. To improve readability and interactability, we increased the reset times after button release and allowed buttons to be filled by either holding or pressing multiple times in succession.
These apply to all hold buttons in Main Menu and Pause Menu.
- UPD: Mancave GridLight puzzle UX improved:
We realized that getting the connection between puzzle components can be challenging, so we disable some elements once they are no longer needed to solve the next puzzles. To clarify: [spoiler]Darts and Cassettes interactions are disabled after Cassettes are placed in correct order.[/spoiler]

notes.title: That day has come—Leila is now available.
notes.content:
Two years of hard work, countless hours of thought, days filled with both joy and stress, conversations, events, tests, plenty of laughter and some tears… and finally, the day has arrived.


We hope you’ll appreciate Leila, her message, the insights she has developed about the world, the lessons she has learned, the solutions she has found, and ultimately, how far she has come on this journey. In these times when humanity—in every corner of the world—needs unity, kindness, equality, and freedom more than ever, we hope that Leila will be our small contribution to this effort.

Guided by our love for humanity’s oldest invention—game—and our belief in power of art to elevate words and spread them far and wide, we set out to create something that might outlast us. Now, we release Leila into the world, not just as a game to entertain, but as a story that celebrates self-forgiveness and solidarity as a path to healing. With tears of pride, we’ll watch her go. She no longer belongs to us alone—she’s now becoming part of a shared collective emotion.

Take good care of her.
